Method of Attack: Infostealer evolving into Remote Access Trojan (RAT) capable of dumping clipboard and browser data, taking screenshots, downloading and executing files, and running on-demand shell commands
Impacted Systems: Workstations of individuals linked to North Korea, including members of United Nations, UNICEF, and Embassies
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing emails containing SRC files that load decoy documents and drop malware
Date of Discovery: Detected in active campaign a few days before report, with historical data linking attacks back to 2014
